map.厂商标称的是空旷无遮挡环境下的理论值。实际使用中，2.4 GHz 信号会被墙体、: The figure quoted by vendors is a theoretical value in open space with no obstructions. In practice, 2.4 GHz signals are significantly attenuated by walls, the human body (which contains water) and co-channel Wi-Fi, so Class 2 devices (common in phones and earbuds) often manage only a few meters indoors — nowhere near the rated 10 m.
